seed_history.implementation: Read-only exact numeric seed lookup across canonical local raw run logs, legacy logs and retained rankings. Logical run IDs, segments and exact ranking links prevent double counting; contradictory identities are rejected. Completed and failed records contribute recorded attempts and known deepest floor. No origin is inferred from a local or imported archive.
seed_history.ui: Existing HeroSelect Set and ranking Copy actions show a shared asynchronous result; newer selection, Clear, scene change and opening another seed dialog invalidate stale notices.
classification: GENERATED_LOCALLY for the unchanged blank-selection random path
UNKNOWN_IMPORTED when available valid local records do not match
seed_history.scoring: All existing scoring code is unchanged. This verified branch has no implemented personal seed-reuse attempt/depth multiplier to connect to. No imported or replay penalty or progress reward formula is invented or activated.
pending_owner_decisions: Numerical personal replay and new-depth progress scoring formula, currently absent from this branch.

contextual_search.implementation: Existing remembered-search chooser recomputes order and hover from current position, observed eligible unconfirmed walls, current room and actual acquired talent footprint. A foreign-floor/branch saved session cannot take first preference. Open areas and CrystalVault/CrystalChoice prefer ordinary Search when there is no interrupted movement to resume.
contextual_search.preserved: Toolbar tap/hold swap, all saved search options, normal Hero.search radius/rounded corners and costs, actual Wide Search and Metamorphosis acquisition, Foresight, saved interruption memory and existing wall return danger checks. No action runs on open/update.
